title: Detect and Stop Procrastination
description: Catch yourself when you’re procrastinating and take quick action to get back on track. Here’s how: - Spot the signs: Are you endlessly scrolling, organizing unnecessarily, or putting off something important? - Ask yourself why: Is the task boring, overwhelming, or unclear? Identify the reason. - Break it down: Take the first tiny step, like opening a document or writing a single sentence. - Set a timer: Commit to just 5 minutes of focused work—often, starting is the hardest part. Procrastination is sneaky, but a few simple moves can help you beat it.
